parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary cluster.

parameters.name: EnableGlobalDomainName
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create a global domain name.

parameters.name: GDNDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the GDN. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

- It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

- It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It must be 2 to 126 characters in length.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
